basic_details.job_title: IUST Project Assistant (Electrical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electrical Engineering, Islamic University of Science and Technology (IUST), Awantipora, Kashmir, is engaging one Project Assistant (PA) under the JKST&IC-funded project "Design & Deployment of Smart Weather Stations for Hyperlocal Data-Driven Precision Horticulture in J&K". The pay is Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA, as admissible, for an initial six months. The essential qualification is a B.Tech. in the listed branches with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent. Online, plus hardcopy to the Department office

content_sections.heading: About the Department and Project
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Department of Electrical Engineering, Islamic University of Science and Technology, Awantipora, Kashmir, and signed by Dr. S. A. Nahvi, Co-Principal Investigator. The post is under the JKST&IC-funded research project on smart weather stations for hyperlocal data-driven precision horticulture in J&K.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is a B.Tech. in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology, Agricultural Engineering, or equivalent, with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent. The notice lists these desirable qualifications and experience: Hands-on experience in sensor interfacing, instrumentation and data acquisition. Practical knowledge of microcontroller-based embedded systems (Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi or similar platforms) and embedded systems programming. Familiarity with IoT technologies, wireless communication protocols and cloud-based data logging. Working knowledge of Python for data processing, analysis and visualisation. Exposure to weather monitoring instruments, environmental sensing systems, or automated weather stations.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly emoluments are Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA, as admissible. The engagement is initially for six months and is extendable, subject to satisfactory performance and availability of project funds. It is purely temporary, performance-based and co-terminus with the project. Payment of emoluments depends on the availability and release of funds by the funding agency.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IUST Project Assistant (PA)
content_sections.text: Submit the application online through the University website, www.iust.ac.in , by 27 November 2026. Submit a hardcopy of the duly submitted application form, with self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates and supporting documents, to the Office of the Department of Electrical Engineering, IUST, Awantipora, by 30 November 2026. Applications submitted through any other mode will not be entertained. Documents named in the notice: Hardcopy of the duly submitted application form. Self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates and supporting documents. At the interview: originals of certificates and documents on educational qualifications, experience, publications and other relevant credentials.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only eligible candidates will be considered for shortlisting, and shortlisting will be based on merit. Shortlisted candidates will be called for a physical interview before the Selection Committee at the IUST campus, Awantipora. The shortlist, and the date, time and venue of the interview, will be notified on the University website. The Selection Committee reserves the right not to recommend any candidate if none of the applicants is found suitable.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Assistant posts has IUST advertised?
faq.answer: The notice announces 01 (One) position of Project Assistant (PA) under the JKST&IC-funded research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IUST Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date for online applications is 27 November 2026. The hardcopy of the application form with documents must be submitted to the Department of Electrical Engineering office by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IUST Project Assistant (PA)?
faq.answer: A B.Tech. in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology, Agricultural Engineering, or equivalent, with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay of the IUST Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The monthly emoluments are Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA, as admissible.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 20,000?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states the pay as Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA, as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IUST Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Apply online through www.iust.ac.in, then submit the hardcopy of the submitted form with self-attested photocopies of certificates to the Department of Electrical Engineering office, IUST, Awantipora, by 30 November 2026. Other modes are not entertained.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are shortlisted on merit and called for a physical interview before the Selection Committee at the IUST campus, Awantipora. The interview date, time and venue will be notified on the University website.

faq.question: Q8. Do I need to apply again if I applied under the earlier advertisement?
faq.answer: Yes. The earlier Advertisement No. IUST/DoEE/26/496 dated 07.10.2026 is cancelled, and earlier applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job, and for how long is the engagement?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary, performance-based and co-terminus with the project. It is initially for six months and extendable, subject to satisfactory performance and availability of project funds.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is admissible for appearing in the interview.
